messages:
maya: Hey runtime folks — can someone quick-check PR #4821 (batching + KV cache + small attn kernel cleanup)? aiming to merge in the 9pm PST maintenance slot if nothing blocks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821
chris: On it. I'll repro the perf runs locally; if CI is green I'm happy to approve. Saw one flaky test earlier though.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed (linux, macos, gpu-smoke) — commit abc1234
jordan: left an inline on the KV TTL docstring; I worry about race with prefetch invalidation. Can you add a short test covering out-of-order invalidate + get?
liam: I'll try a quick fuzz of the cache invalidation tomorrow morning. For the attention kernel change — did you check tensor alignment on older CUDA drivers?
sophia: quick glance: small null-check missing in attn kernel (line 213). Also prefer explicit unit for batch config (ms vs tokens).
maya: thanks — pushing a tiny fix for the null-check and adding a unit comment. Added a basic invalidation test. Patch: ```diff
diff --git a/runtime/kv_cache.py b/runtime/kv_cache.py
index 6a3..b12
--- a/runtime/kv_cache.py
+++ b/runtime/kv_cache.py
@@ -200,6 +200,9 @@ def invalidate(key):
     with lock:
         if key in cache:
-            del cache[key]
+            # ensure proper cleanup for concurrent prefetch
+            entry = cache.pop(key, None)
+            if entry:
+                entry.clear_refs()
```
chris: OK will run perf and smoke. If no regressions, I'll approve and you can merge into the 9pm slot.
jordan: one more nit: add a comment on why we use LRU vs TTL here.
maya: added comment and test. Thanks everyone. If chris approves and no further CI flakes, I'll merge at 21:00 PST :clock9:
liam: :thumbsup: ping me if merge touches infra scripts, I can monitor the queue.
sophia: approved from my side, left a small style nit but not blocking.
chris: LGTM, perf neutral, CI green. Approved.
maya: merging now, will watch metrics and rollback plan ready.
deploy-bot: Release note: merged PR #4821 by maya
maya: followup: will open a small doc on KV invalidation patterns and link to this PR in the runtime handbook.
